companions.task: Build the lit smoker or furnace at 27,3,13 on the chimney wall, which is P4 Hearths' reserved cell and the hall's focal piece; I left that cell empty and designed around it.
Build the shelf and coat rack as proper joinery so the fence rack and standing banner are sturdy and read as furniture, rather than my fence-and-banner stand-in.

left: The official `mcd room build.nbt --rooms rooms.json --only "P2 hall"` still says NEEDS WORK because rooms.json's entrance [89,1,5] is the company store and the lane and porches are not built, so no room in the village can be reached from it yet. With the entrance at the hall's front door cell (file coords 29,6,10) the hall is OK: 17 of 18 floor cells reachable, min light 9, 0 dark, FIT OK. The one unreached cell is the top of the table lantern, which the walk counts as floor.

The stove at 27,3,13 is not placed: elements.md assigns stoves to P4 Hearths (RESERVED cell), so the hall's focal piece depends on P4 placing a lit smoker or furnace there. If P4 does not, the hall has no focal piece.

Coordinate convention: mcd plan and room print file y (plan y + 3), while the build and layers use plan y, and rooms.json boxes are in file y. My hall box [27,3,10,29,6,15] is plan y 3..6 but in file coords that is only the lower part of the room, so the room tool's headroom checks may not see the full height. The lead should confirm rooms.json's convention.

plan.md's checklist has only P1..P6, so there was no room row to tick. I did not tick elements.md items 19 (beds) and 20 (tables), which span several plots, to avoid editing shared plan.md during parallel builds. Items built here: one family bed (bed() both halves), one table (fence and top slab), one lantern (light).
No eye-level interior view was rendered: `mcd rooms` only produced the dollhouse view from above, so the interior is judged from the floor grid and light map, not by looking at it.
